columns.comment: First day of the month (the grain date).
columns.name: month

columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Identity source system (bronze identity master): core_customer, crm_account, kyc_customer, credit_obligor, trade_party, tsy_counterparty or ext_company_master.
columns.name: source_system

columns.comment: Last day of the month - coverage is as at this date.
columns.name: month_end_date

columns.comment: Surrogate key of the dim_client version valid on this row's date (SCD2 as-was join, D11); join to gold.dim_client.golden_client_sk for the client attributes at that time.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: True when the source system holds at least one record of the client available by the month-end.
columns.name: is_present

columns.comment: True when the client has no record in this source at the month-end (e.g. source_system = kyc_customer AND is_missing = golden clients missing from KYC).
columns.name: is_missing

columns.comment: Records of the client in the source at the month-end (within-source duplicates included).
columns.name: n_records

columns.comment: Date the client's first record in this source became available.
columns.name: first_available_date

columns.comment: Date the source last added a record of the client (last updated) up to the month-end.
columns.name: last_record_added_date

columns.comment: Share of the source's key identity fields populated on the client's records (fraction 0-1; 0 when absent).
columns.name: source_field_completeness

columns.comment: True for the core sources core_customer, crm_account and kyc_customer.
columns.name: is_core_source

columns.comment: Source systems (of 7) holding the client at the month-end (client attribute; same on its 7 rows).
columns.name: n_sources_present

columns.comment: True when the client is present in all three core sources at the month-end (client attribute).
columns.name: in_all_core_sources

columns.comment: Months (of the 42) the client has been present in this source up to this month.
columns.name: months_present

columns.comment: True on exactly one row per client-month (the first source system alphabetically) - use it to count golden clients and client attributes without multiplying by 7.
columns.name: is_client_primary_row

columns.comment: True for Sep-2026 rows (coverage at the as-of date).
columns.name: is_latest_month

columns.comment: Golden-record attribute completeness at 30-Sep-2026 = populated / 10 key attributes (legal name, LEI, tax id, country, group, segment, tier, RM, rating, KYC risk), fraction 0-1; latest month only (null earlier). Average over primary rows.
columns.name: attribute_completeness_pct

columns.comment: Key attributes populated on the golden record at 30-Sep-2026 (of n_attributes); latest month only.
columns.name: n_attributes_populated

columns.comment: Key attributes assessed (10); latest month only.
columns.name: n_attributes

columns.comment: Key attributes missing on the golden record at 30-Sep-2026, comma-separated (e.g. lei_like_id, tax_id); latest month only.
columns.name: missing_attributes_text

comment: Golden-record coverage: for every golden client, month (Apr-2023 .. Sep-2026) and identity source system (core_customer, crm_account, kyc_customer, credit_obligor, trade_party, tsy_counterparty, ext_company_master) whether the client is present in that source, with how many records, when the source last added one, and the source's field completeness; plus whether the client is in all core sources (core banking, CRM, KYC) and - on the latest month only - the golden record's attribute completeness. Dense: 7 rows per client-month; count clients with is_client_primary_row. Point-in-time per month: do not add months. Grain: one row per golden client per month per identity source system.
